units.source_text: 天色向晓，风声凄厉，严霜载途，行人似觉身上衣衫皆已冻冰。

en.t: As dawn drew near, the wind sounded bleak and piercing, heavy frost covered the road, and travelers felt as though even the clothes on their bodies had frozen solid.

units.source_text: 匂亲王上马之后，犹自屡次回头，恋恋不舍。

en.t: After Prince Niou mounted his horse, he still looked back again and again, unable to tear himself away.

units.source_text: 但因许多随从人员在旁，未便任意回马，只得急急忙忙地前行，昏昏沉沉地离开了宇治。

en.t: But because so many attendants were beside him, he could not freely turn his horse back, and could only hurry onward, leaving Uji in a dazed state.

units.source_text: 这两个五位官员——大内记道定和左卫门大夫时方——起初随侍匂亲王马头两旁步行，经过了险峻的山路之后，方才跨上自己的马。

en.t: These two fifth-rank officials, Ouchi no Ki Michisada and Saemon no Daibu Tokikata, first walked in attendance on either side of Prince Niou's horse, and only mounted their own horses after they had passed the steep mountain road.

units.source_text: 匂亲王但觉马蹄践踏岸边薄冰之声，也很凄凉悲惨。

en.t: To Prince Niou, even the sound of the horse's hooves trampling the thin ice along the bank seemed unbearably lonely and sorrowful.

units.source_text: 他回思从前也曾为了恋情而走这条山路，觉得对这山乡似有奇缘。

en.t: He thought back to how he had once traveled this mountain road for love before, and felt that he seemed to have a strange bond with this mountain village.
